docs.text: Today at the dog park I sat and listened while an old man described the boat he’s restoring, with the goal of taking it through all of the great lakes. People are cool man.

For tomorrow's Hallowednesday Steam, I'm playing a little-known, strange PS2 game from Suda/Grasshopper... Michigan: Report from Hell! 🎃 Join me as I document some bizarre & spooky events around Lake Michigan! Let's get the scoop @ 9am PT!! 📹
WE HAVE ANOTHER STUCK BOAT, Y’ALL! THIS TIME, IT’S PERSONAL! IT’S STUCK SOMEPLACE COLD, SKANKY, AND DREARY…GOOD OL’ LAKE ERIE!!
MA, A BOAT GOT STUCK IN THE GREAT LAKES AGAIN!!
Today my boat gets paroled from winter prison! Splash in T-minus 3 hours! Finally I get to start making my way out of the Great Lakes heading for warmer waters!
GIRLS THE GOODTIME GOT STUCK IN THE LAKE ANOTHER BOAT STUCK FOR LAKE ERIE IN SUMMER 2025
The big ass boat is no longer stuck in cold, skanky, dreary Lake Erie!
Not doing Great Lakes stuff myself at the moment but collaborate with lots of great folks working on them, so maybe someday!
Fellow Great Lakes #BoatNerds Check it out: mad scramble before winter lay up in progress. Where are my fellow boat nerds?
Which one of you was the one posting all the stuck boats?? There's another one! This time in Lake Erie ice. 😨

My signed-in feed right now, in order, is: "I dumpster-dove a NeXT workstation PC. Can it still run?" "Have you heard this creepy story about the crew of a freighter marooned in Lake Superior in December?" "Soviet ejection seats: maybe just as bad as crash-landing?"

They didn't like to talk about it but they were hunting for something. They trained at Great lakes we would visit there. One taught me to play guitar and one taught me to cook. Thank you, I need some good memories today.

I've been on a #Transpac race & race on Lake Erie.
